claim_en: SEIR PASSED: WE WENT ROUND MOUNT SEIR MANY DAYS; ENOUGH — TURN NORTHWARD; YOU PASS THE BORDER OF YOUR BROTHERS THE SONS OF ESAU: CONTEND NOT, I WILL NOT GIVE YOU A FOOTBREADTH, SEIR IS ESAU'S POSSESSION; BUY FOOD AND WATER FOR MONEY — THESE FORTY YEARS YOU HAVE LACKED NOTHING; WE PASSED FROM ELATH AND EZION-GEBER BY THE WAY OF THE WILDERNESS OF MOAB. 'We went round Mount Seir many days' one seat (Numbers 21:4 the first telling); 'enough for you' the phrase's second seat in the speech; 'your brothers the sons of Esau' one seat (Numbers 20:14's embassy word); 'CONTEND NOT' the contend-root's hitpael at 2:5, 9, 19 and the command at 2:24; 'not so much as a footbreadth' one seat; 'AS A POSSESSION' seven seats (Balaam's 24:18 first; Onkelos the same word at 2:5, 9, 19); 'FOOD YOU SHALL BUY ... WATER YOU SHALL BUY' the grain-buying verb of Joseph's brothers and the dig-verb in its buying sense (Hosea 3:2's lemma), Numbers 20:19's offer to Edom the kin; 'these forty years' three seats; 'you have lacked nothing' one seat (Onkelos 'he supplied your need, the Memra in your aid'); Ezion-geber two tokens as at Numbers 33:35-36. No piska on these verses.
middah: ink (the seats of the circuit, the contend-verb, the possession-word, the buying-verbs and the lack-clause censused against Numbers 20-21 and 33)

claim_en: MOAB PASSED AND THE EMIM: HARASS NOT MOAB — AR IS THE SONS OF LOT'S POSSESSION; THE EMIM DWELT THERE FORMERLY, TALL AS THE ANAKIM, RECKONED REPHAIM; IN SEIR THE HORITES, WHOM ESAU'S SONS DISPOSSESSED AS ISRAEL DID TO THE LAND OF HIS POSSESSION; RISE AND CROSS THE BROOK ZERED — THIRTY-EIGHT YEARS FROM KADESH-BARNEA UNTIL THE MEN OF WAR WERE CONSUMED, THE HAND OF THE LORD DISCOMFITING THEM. 'Harass not Moab' the besiege-root by the lemma; Ar six seats (Onkelos Lehayath); the Emim Genesis 14:5's (Onkelos 'the terrible ones'); 'great and many and tall as the Anakim' 2:10 and 2:21; Rephaim nineteen seats of the token; 'FORMERLY' the Torah's three seats, all this chapter's; the Horites Genesis 14:6 and 36:20's; 'as Israel did to the land of his possession' one seat — the retelling from after the conquest; 'the brook Zered' two seats; 'THIRTY-EIGHT YEARS' three seats, the parser [38]; 'UNTIL THE WHOLE GENERATION WAS CONSUMED' Numbers 32:13's clause at its second seat; 'the men of war' twenty seats; 'to discomfit them' 2:15 and Esther 9:24 (Onkelos 'a plague from before the LORD'). No piska on these verses.
middah: ink (the verbs', names' and clauses' seats censused; 2:14's clause matched to Numbers 32:13; the years measured by the parser)

claim_en: AMMON PASSED AND THE ZAMZUMMIM: WHEN THE MEN OF WAR WERE CONSUMED, THE LORD SPOKE TO ME — YOU PASS AR, THE BORDER OF MOAB, AND COME NEAR THE SONS OF AMMON: HARASS THEM NOT, IT IS LOT'S; THAT TOO IS A LAND OF REPHAIM, THE AMMONITES' ZAMZUMMIM, DESTROYED BEFORE THEM AS THE HORITES BEFORE ESAU TO THIS DAY; AND THE AVVIM IN VILLAGES TO GAZA, DESTROYED BY THE CAPHTORIM FROM CAPHTOR. 2:17 'AND THE LORD SPOKE TO ME' the Bible's ONLY seat of the form (the speech's six other frames say 'said'); 'the land of Rephaim' 2:20 and 3:13; Zamzummim a hapax (Onkelos 'the schemers'); 'in their place' 2:12, 21, 22, 23; 'to this day' 2:22 and 3:14, twelve Torah seats; the Avvim four seats (Joshua 13:3's Philistine list); 'in villages' one seat (Onkelos 'in Defiah'); 'THE CAPHTORIM WHO CAME FROM CAPHTOR' Genesis 10:14's Caphtorim, Amos 9:7 and Jeremiah 47:4 the prophets' pair (Onkelos 'Cappadocians'). No piska on these verses.
middah: ink (the frame's unique form measured on the whole Bible; the names' seats censused; the translation's renderings' seats)

check.note: 'Zamzummim' — a hapax; the Ammonites' name for the Rephaim; Onkelos 'the schemers'

claim_en: THE ARNON CROSSED: RISE, JOURNEY, CROSS THE BROOK ARNON — SEE, I HAVE GIVEN SIHON THE AMORITE INTO YOUR HAND; BEGIN TO POSSESS, CONTEND WITH HIM IN BATTLE; THIS DAY I BEGIN TO PUT THE DREAD OF YOU ON THE PEOPLES UNDER THE WHOLE HEAVEN, WHO SHALL HEAR AND TREMBLE AND BE IN ANGUISH. 'Rise, journey, cross the brook Arnon' one seat; 'see, I have given' eight seats; 'begin, possess' 2:24 and 2:31 (Onkelos 'begin to drive him out'); the contend-verb turned from refusal to command; 'THE DREAD OF YOU AND THE FEAR OF YOU' one seat (Exodus 23:27's terror, 11:25's dread, Rahab's Joshua 2:9 the run); 'under the whole heaven' seven Bible seats, the flood's first; 'AND TREMBLE AND BE IN ANGUISH' EXODUS 15:14's pair at the sea, its second seat (Psalm 77:17 the third). No piska on these verses.
middah: ink (the imperatives' and the dread-clause's seats censused; Exodus 15:14's pair found at its second seat)

check.note: 'the dread of you' — the dread of you and the fear of you, one seat; Exodus 23:27's terror the kin
